# Map Tools

`ghost_ctab_tools`

Map tools on the cTab display, ported natively from Better CAS
Environment.

<!-- generated below this line by tools/gen_addon_readmes.py - do not edit -->

## Requires

- `cba_xeh` _(external)_
- `ghost_main`

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.

## Ships

12 functions.

## CBA settings

| Setting | Type | Name |
|---|---|---|
| `ghost_ctab_tools_mainMap` | CHECKBOX | Tool Picker on the Main Map |
| `ghost_ctab_tools_markerColour` | LIST | Tool Marker Colour |
